verdict.rationale: Square has extensive documented APIs (Payments, Refunds, Webhooks, Sandbox) and an official Node.js SDK with copy-paste code snippets, suggesting a quick-start path exists. However, the evidence pack lacks a concrete quickstart/tutorial artifact demonstrating a full end-to-end flow in under a day, and OpenAPI/docs.md probes returned 404s, indicating weaker machine-readable or consolidated onboarding docs.
